select r.id, r.room_code, r.owner_user_id, r.theme_snapshot, r.status, r.created_at, r.updated_at from co_create_rooms r inner join co_create_room_members m on m.room_id = r.id where r.status = 'active' and m.user_id = #{userId} order by r.updated_at desc, r.created_at desc limit 1

mapper.insert: insert into co_create_room_members ( room_id, user_id, nickname, avatar_url, track_color, route_points, current_position, completed_missions, is_tracking, last_active_at, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{roomId}, #{userId}, #{nickname}, #{avatarUrl}, #{trackColor}, #{routePoints}, #{currentPosition}, #{completedMissions}, #{isTracking}, now(), now(), now() ) on duplicate key update nickname = values(nickname), avatar_url = values(avatar_url), track_color = values(track_color), updated_at = now(), last_active_at = now()
mapper.update: update co_create_room_members set route_points = #{routePoints}, current_position = #{currentPosition}, completed_missions = #{completedMissions}, is_tracking = #{isTracking}, updated_at = now(), last_active_at = now() where room_id = #{roomId} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: delete from co_create_room_members where room_id = #{roomId} and user_id = #{userId}
